before.body:
PR #451 brought retained test snapshots onto main. The release resolver parses their copied front matter as live artifacts and refuses RLS-SEH-026 with `duplicate artifact ID at trusted main head: VREC-EVD-001`.

The repair applies the validator's existing directory-exclusion rules before publication helpers parse engineering Markdown. Git-tree discovery, release-record search, first-parent history and the checkout rehearsal selector share the same boundary. Real duplicate rejection and explicit evidence validation remain intact.

The operator approved WO-RLO-009 and VER-RLO-006 and authorized implementation. The operator also accepted the bounded scope extension: one allocation test now renames its disposable `.git` directory instead of deleting read-only Git objects. Every assertion is unchanged. DISC08 requires that case and both full platform suites to pass.

Validation:

- 94 focused publication and CI-policy tests pass on Windows and Linux, including eight new discovery regression tests.
- Both platforms reproduce the original failure on frozen main `fb6f60d5069706e8ae0ca69d1263285cbb904f45`, then resolve the repaired catalog to independently checked, unchanged RLS-SEH-026 identities.
- At corrected candidate `cda9474c71a9f14b51d16a3f22ab6ecabff12e89`, all 1,142 tests pass on each platform: Windows has 23 skips; Linux has four. Neither platform adds skips. The corrected isolated allocation case also passes on both.
- Isolated released SE Harness 0.17.0 integrity, graph, review-preflight, scope and mechanical handoff checks pass. The handoff is rebound to the approved extension.
- Every pre-existing engineering blob and mode is preserved. The corrected candidate archive has 9,992 entries, below the unchanged 10,000 limit.

Raw results, historical failures, approval receipts and the handoff are retained under `docs/engineering/release-orchestration/evidence/WO-RLO-009/`. All 17 hosted checks passed at the previous evidence head `a53f5663bb812aa0c91d9f01ad2d104311d20fc9`; checks for the updated head are pending and will be reported separately.

**WO-RLO-009 remains in_progress.** No execution delegation is granted. Completion, VREC preparation, independent verification and merge remain separate decisions. VREC-RLO-009 is reserved, not prepared. This PR does not publish a release or change managed files, CI definitions or the portable validator.

Harness-Work-Order: WO-RLO-009
